payload.claim: Criterion 1's witness test is unusually dense — it carries two layers, seven concerns across two fixtures, a REBUT edit, a review-commit edit, an inserted-lines shift, a Latin-1 trap and a trailing-whitespace/apply.whitespace trap, all in one test. This matches the project's established style for single dense witnesses (e.g. _later_diff_fixture), so it is not out of place, but a single off-by-one while porting the spec's prescribed line numbers into code would be easy to introduce, even though I verified the numbers as given are internally consistent.
